findings.current: “Keep installing them. Dozens of times. Hundreds, if necessary.”
findings.defect: “If necessary” adds a condition not present in the source, which states emphatically that they should keep installing the formations—dozens or hundreds of times.
findings.rationale: The Korean “수십, 수백 번” gives the repeated quantities without making hundreds contingent on necessity.
findings.replacement: “Keep installing them. Dozens of times. Hundreds.”

summary: The assembled chapter is largely faithful, with one omitted dialogue turn and one small added qualification.
